content.text:
This file is already quite polished (accessible, handles reduced-motion/contrast/forced-colors, persists state, keyboard support). I'll add a few targeted improvements rather than rewrite it:

1. `role="status"` without `aria-atomic="true"` can cause some screen readers to only announce the diff, not the full color name.
2. No Home/End key support to jump to first/last color.
3. The `(hover: none)` check for "Tap" vs "Click" only runs once, so it won't update if input mode changes (e.g. tablet with attached mouse).

I couldn't open a browser to visually verify (blocked by permissions), but the changes are small and syntactically straightforward. Summary of improvements to `0.html`:

- Added `aria-atomic="true"` to the status element so screen readers reliably announce the full color name.
- Made the "Click"/"Tap" hint text reactively update via a `matchMedia` change listener instead of a one-time check.
- Added `Home`/`End` keyboard support to jump straight to the first/last color, and updated the hint text to document it.
